Privacy Policy

Protecting your personal data is important to us. Below we inform you about which data is processed when you visit this website.

1. Data controller

René Müller
Schlossstraße 10
56856 Zell (Mosel), Germany

2. Hosting

This website is hosted via GitHub Pages (GitHub Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, USA, or its European group company). The domain is registered with Namecheap Inc. When you access the site, GitHub automatically processes technical information in so-called server log files transmitted by your browser. This usually includes the IP address, date and time of the request, the page accessed, the browser used and the operating system.

This data is used exclusively for technical operation, delivering the website and protecting against misuse. We do not combine it with other data sources. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in a secure and functional provision of the website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

3. Fonts

The fonts used on this website (Fraunces, Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono) are hosted locally as part of the website. This means no connection is made to servers operated by Google or other third parties, and no data is transmitted to third parties.

4. Cookies and tracking

This website does not use cookies and does not use any tracking or analytics tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, etc.). No usage profiles are created.

5. Contacting us by email

If you contact us by email, we will store the data you provide (e.g. name, email address, content of your message) in order to process your request. We do not pass this data on without your consent.

The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR if your request relates to the initiation of a tenancy, or otherwise Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in processing your request). The data will be deleted as soon as it is no longer required for processing, at the latest once the rental has been concluded or finally declined.

6. SSL/TLS encryption

For security reasons, this website uses SSL/TLS encryption. You can recognise an encrypted connection by the prefix https:// in your browser's address bar.

7. Your rights

As a data subject, you have the following rights towards us, provided the respective legal requirements are met:

  • Access to the data stored about you (Art. 15 GDPR)
  • Rectification of inaccurate data (Art. 16 GDPR)
  • Erasure of your data (Art. 17 GDPR)
  • Restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
  • Objection to processing (Art. 21 GDPR)
  • Data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
  • Lodging a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, e.g. the one responsible for your place of residence
